package.name: moveit_teleop_record
package.description:
Episode recording for imitation-learning data collection.
Split out from moveit_teleop_core so that rosbag2 (and later pyarrow and the LeRobot toolchain) are not forced on someone who only wants to jog an arm. Conversion to a training format is an OFFLINE script, deliberately not part of the runtime: keeping the training schema out of the teleop stack is what stops it leaking in.
